nina: quick flag — Sparrow's onboarding report shows repeated p95 latency breaches on /api/complete over last 7d. renewal call in 10 days; need evidence bundle + provisional credit calc.
marco: paste the numbers? p50/p95/p99 and uptime please
li: SLA: 99.95% uptime. SLO: 95% requests < 180ms on /api/complete. Last 7d: uptime 99.96%, p50=85ms, p95=360ms, p99=820ms. Breach pattern: 3 days with p95>180ms, two are business days.
marco: ok — contract triggers credit if p95>180ms on >1 business day in rolling 7d. we'll need: timeseries CSV, top traces, autoscale events, and the provisional credit spreadsheet.
slo-bot: automated: 2025-08-18T07:12Z - p95 exceeded 180ms on 3 days this window; incident CS-1677 opened.
nina: owners: marco (metrics + credit calc), li (traces + infra timeline), legal-bot (provisional wording). deadline 48h so CSM can review before renewal prep.
li: infra note — early hypothesis: cache cold starts at peak; will enable prefix caching canary and add one warm replica for 24h. canary toggle scheduled 02:30 UTC tonight. will post 6h snapshot.
marco: draft credit calc formula: (breach_days/7) * monthly_commitment * credit_rate. will compute two scenarios: no remediation, remediation-adjusted.
legal-bot: automated: include "provisional" language and audit clause. credits subject to metric verification; provide CSV + trace ids.
sparrow-contact: we can run a 30min synthetic at 03:00 UTC to help validate warmup; happy to coordinate.
nina: perfect. comms plan: 1-page summary + appendix (metrics, traces, timeline) + provisional credit appendix. if warmup shows improvement within 48h we adjust credit downward. I'll consolidate and send to legal for signoff. any blockers?
marco: none. aiming to upload draft bundle by 17:00 PST today.
li: will attach traces and canary metrics to CS-1677.
nina: thanks team — closing loop here once drafts are in.
